title: Ding Talagawa da ring Tore
intro: keng milabas a panaun, metung a masikan a sibilisasyun ing tinalakad, a mipakilala kareng kayang makapagmulalang gawa ning konstruksyun ampo sikanan. Ing pamisanmetung a ini mirinan yang dakal a pibandyan ampo pisikal a sikanan, pero pinili da ing dalan ning pamaglaban laban keng banal a mensahi a peparala na para gabayan la. Ing karelang istorya magsilbi yang malalam a aral keng annals ning amlat, metung a testamento kareng bunga ning pamagtakwil keng katutwan.
clues: Midinan kaming maragul a sikanan at katas, ali kalupa da reng aliwang tau keng kekaming panaun.
Kilala kami keng pamaglalang mangaragul a istruktura ampo matas a asias keng balang matas a lugal, isipan mi na mabye kami kapilan man.
Metung a tubud ibat kekatamu ing mitubud ban babalaan na katamu, inaus na katamu ban samban ta ya mu ing Allah at lakuan ta la ring kekatamung idolo.
Mayabang ming kitnan ing kekaming tubud, kukutang mi nung dinatang la kekami para mu samban mi ya ing Allah at paburen mi ing sasamban da reng kekaming pipumpunan.
Ing gabun mi binindisyunan yang mula, sibul, at mataba a marangle, oneng ing kekaming kasaganaan pepakit mi king kekaming sariling sikanan, e king kekaming Miglalang.
Para keng kekaming e kapaniwalan ampo pamaglibak, mesira kami keng makatakut, masikan a angin a menabu kilub ning dakal a aldo ampo bengi.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
